newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Int'l to issue 150 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Int'l to issue 150 mln new shrs.

text.p: Optical products distributor Shenzhen International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to issue 150 million new shares at HK$0.60 per share to its controlling shareholder to raise a net HK$87 million.

It said the controlling shareholder, Shenzhen Building Materials Industrial Group Company, and it's 80 percent unit Euroway Developments Ltd agreed to subscribe for 100 million and 50 million new shares respectively after a share placement.
Shenzhen Building and Euroway Developments had agreed to place 100 million and 50 million existing shares they held in Shenzhen International with private investors at HK$0.60 each.
The placing and subscription price represented a 6.25 percent discount to the shares' Monday close of HK$0.64, the company said in a statement.

Shenzhen International said the proceeds would be used for the expansion of its Hong Kong and China operations, including the building materials business, the property investment and optical business and to further strengthen the company's cash flow position.
The holding of Shenzhen Building and Euroway Developments would be diluted to 49.04 percent and 18.65 percent from 53.73 and 20.45 percent after the placement and share subscription.
